why: An April 2025 arXiv preprint, 'Chern's Conjecture in the Dupin case,' proves the conjecture for closed proper Dupin hypersurfaces with constant mean curvature in several sub-cases (g=3; g=4 with constant scalar or Lie curvature; g=6 with constant Lie curvature), settling special cases of this exact conjecture.
